dct_description_sm: Timor-Leste administrative level 0-3 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01. This dataset is structured into 3 levels: - Admin 1: 13 nan - Admin 2: 65 nan - Admin 3: 442 nan Dates associated with this dataset: - 30 October 2025: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness - 11 September 2020: valid for use by the humanitarian community - 01 January 2020: last edit to the dataset before publishing - 01 January 2020: boundaries created by the source Contributed by [OCHA Regional Office for Asia and the Pacific (ROAP)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-roap). Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx). Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
